description: The runbook over WhatsApp: Marina asks for the ten-lesson package and an initial assessment, the code prices the cart (R$ 479,90), she accepts, the order is confirmed and the bolepix issued, the QR goes into the conversation with the copy-and-paste as its own message underneath, the sandbox payer pays, and the agent writes 'recebemos, pedido confirmado'.
